transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get our finalization meeting underway for the 'Tide Memory' installation. Before I can sign off on the final exhibition and opening-night package, I need to hear confirmed production requirements from each of you. Technical producer, rights counsel, accessibility coordinator, and guest liaison — please report your confirmed requirements so we can get everything on the form. Let's start with technical operations.

transcript.text: I need to report a confirmed technical requirement from my equipment test. The installation runs reliably on exactly six stations, not eight. Additionally, each headset requires a five-minute sanitation reset after a 15-minute viewing, which means each timed session must be exactly 20 minutes. I recorded this in the technical worksheet after yesterday's systems check, though the worksheet hasn't been attached to the festival master brief yet.

transcript.text: I have a confirmed rights compliance requirement to report. I received the countersigned license addendum from the distributor this morning.
